page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred lines of display type from top to bottom, with a rule and a printer's imprint at the foot. No margin text. Faint show-through from the reverse side and a handwritten "5" at top right are not printed text.

main_text.l: SS. Theol. Doct. & Ling. Hebr. Profess.
Ad diem 3[?] Decembr. Anni hujus occidui,
in hyberno Theol. Auditorio, horis consuetis

page.notes: A stain overlies the "3" in "Ad diem 3" and the Greek word after "publicam" is set in a swash type that is hard to read; both are marked [?]. The "DE" line has a decorative swash form of the D and E. The show-through text from the reverse side is excluded, as are the handwritten marks at top right and bottom right.
